# Phase Router MVP validation

**Date:** 2026-10-19. This is an engineering check on synthetic profiles generated by the same fixed CIF renderer; it is not experimental validation.

## Environment and sources

- Python 3.11.9; NumPy 2.4.6, SciPy 1.17.1 and Matplotlib are available. The optional UI dependencies were installed only into the ignored `.venvs/phase-router-mvp` environment in this worktree.
- Pymatgen, PyTorch, and pytest are absent. The MVP therefore uses its own small CIF reader/renderer and Python's standard `unittest` runner. Streamlit 1.66.0 launched headlessly on port 8765, and `http://127.0.0.1:8765/_stcore/health` returned `ok`.
- Source CIFs and SHA-256 values are listed in [`pxrd_router_mvp/candidates/README.md`](../pxrd_router_mvp/candidates/README.md). MgO and CeO₂ come from COD 9000505 and 9009008; BaTiO₃ is the already present COD 9014273 snapshot. CIF source article metadata and attribution notices are preserved.
- No frozen classifier weights were found; the adapter reports `classifier unavailable`. No random model or stored predictions were substituted.

## Tests

Command:

```powershell
python -m unittest discover -s pxrd_router_mvp/tests -v
```

Result: **8 tests passed** in 5.25 s. Coverage includes CIF parsing/rendering for all three materials, noisy end-to-end routing and lattice fitting, optional-prior non-exclusion, filename-independent ranking, repeatable demo generation, CSV header parsing, descending-axis handling, duplicate rejection, negative intensity rejection and wavelength validation.

## Synthetic demos

Commands were `python -m pxrd_router_mvp.demo --candidate <candidate-id>` for each bundled candidate, default seed `271828`, wavelength `1.5406 Å`, generated 10–80° profiles, 0.04° grid, known 0.4%/−0.3% cell perturbation as applicable, 0.025° zero shift, 0.16° Gaussian FWHM, 0.025 baseline and deterministic Gaussian noise (`σ=0.003`). The selected correct CIF ranked first each time:

| Generated CIF | fitted a (Å) | fitted c (Å) | fitted zero shift (°) | fit RMSE | rank |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| BaTiO₃ P4mm | 4.00194 | 4.01393 | 0.02498 | 0.00299 | 1 of 3 |
| MgO rocksalt | 4.22886 | — | 0.02512 | 0.00299 | 1 of 3 |
| CeO₂ fluorite | 5.43265 | — | 0.02514 | 0.00300 | 1 of 3 |

These are self-consistency figures because both input and fit use the same renderer. They do not establish accuracy on actual measurements, unseen CIFs, mixtures, other instruments, or a general phase-identification task. A small residual is not a calibrated confidence score.

## Deliberate gaps

- **Real experimental validation: NOT DONE.** No authorized measured spectrum with instrument wavelength metadata was available.
- **Frozen crystal-system prior: UNAVAILABLE.** No checkpoint files or PyTorch were found. The phase matcher evaluates all three CIFs without it.
- **Streamlit smoke:** headless startup succeeded in the ignored worktree venv; local health endpoint returned `ok`. No browser-based visual inspection was performed.
- **Physics scope:** neutral-atom `f(s)=Z`, kinematic structure factors, Lorentz-polarization correction and Gaussian broadening only. No anomalous/thermal scattering factors, Kα1/Kα2 splitting, instrument calibration/profile, sample displacement, texture, absorption, phase mixtures or Rietveld model.
- **Candidate scope:** exactly three source CIFs; no database-wide search, no chemical formula inference, no polymorph completeness claim. Lattice bounds stay within ±3.5% of the source CIF cell.
